title: Karin Kiho: 'Where I come from?' experience list with linked companies
note: About has a hand-drawn tag 'Where I come from?' on a string, then two columns, PROFESSIONAL and ACADEMIC. Each row: role (18px light), company name as a mustard link (#b59521) with a pin icon and country, and dates right-aligned, with a ⊕ to expand and dashed rules between rows. 'What I can do?' above is three cards (Design / Front-end / Interactive) with a different hand-cut pattern header each. Worth reusing: this is almost exactly what Petra's Endava → Polygon history needs, with company names as links out.
